subject: Animation
title: Kizazi Moto: Afrofuturism in Animation
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Kizazi Moto: Afrofuturism in Animation.

hook.text: Disney released Kizazi Moto: Generation Fire in 2023, an anthology of animated shorts from African creators.

buildup.text: Each short was created by a different African animation studio, showcasing the continent's diverse visual styles.

discovery.text: The anthology explored Afrofuturism — blending African traditions with science fiction and fantasy themes.

twist.text: Disney funded the project but gave African creators unusual creative freedom to tell their own stories.

climax.text: Kizazi Moto proved that African animators could produce world-class work given the right platform and funding.

punchline.text: African storytellers used Disney's platform to show the world their future.

quiz.question: What was the significance of Kizazi Moto for African animation?
options: It was Disney's first animated feature set in Africa
It showcased diverse African animation studios and proved they could produce world-class Afrofuturist work
It was the first animated show dubbed in African languages

details.summary: Kizazi Moto: Generation Fire is a Disney+ anthology of animated shorts by African creators exploring Afrofuturist themes. The series gave African animators unprecedented global visibility and demonstrated the continent's creative potential.
details.whyItMatters: Kizazi Moto proved African animation could reach global audiences through major platforms. It represented a significant step toward giving African creators direct access to international distribution.
takeaways: Kizazi Moto showcased African animation talent on a global platform
The anthology explored Afrofuturist themes through diverse animation styles
It demonstrated Disney's investment in diverse global animation voices

faq.question: What is Kizazi Moto about?
faq.answer: It is an anthology of animated shorts by creators from across Africa, exploring science fiction and Afrofuturist themes. Each short has a different style and story, showcasing the diversity of African animation talent and storytelling perspectives.

faq.question: How was Kizazi Moto produced?
faq.answer: Disney partnered with Triggerfish Animation in South Africa to identify and support African creators. Studios across the continent produced individual shorts with creative freedom, mentorship support, and access to Disney's global distribution platform.
